description: This file contains implementation of system control block functions for ARM Cortex-M processors within the Zephyr RTOS, including system reset, MPU configuration clearing, and hardware initialization at boot.

methods.name: sys_arch_reboot
methods.description: Weak function to reset the system, calls NVIC_SystemReset.

methods.name: z_arm_clear_arm_mpu_config
methods.description: Clears all MPU region configurations depending on the MPU type (ARM or NXP).

methods.name: z_arm_init_arch_hw_at_boot
methods.description: Initializes hardware at boot by disabling interrupts, resetting cache settings, clearing MPU configs, and disabling NVIC interrupts.
